description: Integrate AppLens into the Triveni Point host application. Additive-only changes: add the library as a local file: dependency, initialize AppLens in App.tsx, and render the <AppLens /> component. Also write the library README. Depends on FEAT-001, FEAT-002, FEAT-003. This is the final integration FEAT.
steps: Add '@applens/react-native': 'file:../AppLens' to the 'dependencies' section of /Users/sunilkumar/Desktop/project/AppLens/triveni-point/package.json. No other changes to package.json.

Update /Users/sunilkumar/Desktop/project/AppLens/triveni-point/tsconfig.json to add a path mapping for '@applens/react-native': ['../AppLens/src/index.ts'] under compilerOptions.paths, and add '../AppLens' under 'include' so TypeScript can resolve the library types.

Update /Users/sunilkumar/Desktop/project/AppLens/triveni-point/App.tsx: (1) add import at top: `import { AppLens as AppLensDebugger, AppLens as AppLensSingleton } from '@applens/react-native';` — actually use cleaner naming: import the component as AppLensDebugUI and the singleton as AppLensDebug. Initialize in a useEffect or top-level call BEFORE the return: call `AppLensDebug.initialize({ enabled: __DEV__, network: true, console: true, events: true, ai: true, projectRoot: '/Users/sunilkumar/Desktop/project/AppLens/triveni-point' })`. Render `{__DEV__ && <AppLensDebugUI />}` as the LAST child inside SafeAreaProvider, after RootNavigator. This is purely additive. NOTE: the barrel export from src/index.ts exports the singleton as 'AppLens' (the class instance) and the React component as a separate named export. Make sure naming is unambiguous — use the exact export names from FEAT-001/002 index.ts.
Run `cd /Users/sunilkumar/Desktop/project/AppLens/triveni-point && npm install` (or yarn install) to link the local package.
Run `cd /Users/sunilkumar/Desktop/project/AppLens/triveni-point && npx tsc --noEmit` to confirm the integration type-checks cleanly.

Create /Users/sunilkumar/Desktop/project/AppLens/AppLens/README.md documenting: what AppLens is, installation (file: path + npm install), initialization API (AppLens.initialize options table), the <AppLens /> component usage, AppLens.trackEvent API, how to configure the AI key, list of tabs and what they show, the KnowledgeGraph/CodeIndexer pattern for AI code awareness.
